implReport.summary:
All 8 items of look-pass-5 are implemented or reported, but acceptance 3 and 4 are only partly met. The opening still cannot be played to its end in a browser on either test seed: seed 1 stops after the outcome card, seed 2 floods. The low-quality triangle count is +5.2 % against the 5 % line. Typecheck is clean and the tests are green per touched folder. The full report with picture paths is docs/design/tasks/look-pass-5-report.md.

1. The founding time-lapse, outcome card and failure card now use a dedicated elevated shot with a slice cut through the cell. The pictures on seeds 1 and 2 show the cell above the card with the queen and workers in it. In a real hand-dug founding the queen lays in the shaft throat, so the real time-lapse shows an almost empty cell.
2. Backdrop white speckle: fixed by a per-primitive fuzz flag, so flat faces no longer get the hashed-alpha fuzz. The speckled band along the horizon is the rim haze and is unchanged.
3. Kitchen-door wall foot: the streaks came from interpolated varyings (a 250 mm face tested just under 250 on thin pixel lines), fixed with flat varyings. The pale veil came from the 65 mm vent-course bands getting no fogKeep, fixed in faceDetail. The weep-vent bars still read as white ticks.
4. Moulded plastic: new plastic finish with orange-peel stipple, part line, worn edges and foot dirt. It is visible close up; the foot dirt is subtle.
5. Resolved alert under a blocking card: a resolved card now leaves at once while a blocking card is up. This is covered by unit tests only; the debug-injected alert is dropped by the sim, so I could not take a browser before picture.
6. Inspector pictures taken on a live colony (queen, egg, larva, pupa, chamber):
   - Fixes: unit strings with raw floats ("14.774999999999999") are rounded; a queen's meaningless "callow (0 game days)" row is hidden; "1 game days" is now singular; a pinned egg gets a ring in the colony view.
   - The brood is a labelled stand-in: `cheat.spawnBrood`.
   - Possession-camera pictures: nest shaft at three depths, the chamber, a 12 degree stone top and a 16 degree slope. The seed 1 start has no 45 degree ground, so that case is untested.
7. First hour: a real firstplay run passes beats 1-12 on seed 1 and 1-10 on seed 2, then fails for sim causes. Beats 13-25 were seen only with the opening cheated (stand-in run with soft failures). controls, views, lifecycle, stage1a strict, save (second run) and panels pass; panels used 2 labelled stand-ins. The report lists the causes and a most-serious-first "still unfinished" list citing pictures. I also fixed the queen panel title hidden behind the chamber meter in beats 07 and 08, verified in `firstplay/seed1-hudfix`.
8. MANUAL.md and README.md corrected and extended with the known problems; tests/docs pass.

findings.title: Founding shot camera jumps tens of millimetres in one frame when the subject sphere changes
findings.where: src/game/flows/founding/shotSubject.ts:42-46 and src/game/views/viewDirector.ts updateRig (the shot branch: f.pose = this.shot.pose, with no easing)
findings.detail: The shot's subject radius is the largest distance from the centroid to the queen, the loose brood and any colony worker within WORKER_REACH_BU (10 BU). Nothing smooths it. When a worker steps across the 10 BU line, the radius jumps from 0.4 mm to 40.3 mm, and the camera distance (proportional to the radius, never below the 4.5 BU minimum) jumps with it in the same frame. The same happens when a nurse picks up a brood item (carried brood is dropped from the centroid) or when brood is put down higher (cutY jumps). This is the 'no frame-to-frame jumps' rule of CAM_MAX_REL_SPEED_L, and it applies at the outcome card, exactly when the first workers walk in and out of the cell. Reproduction: src/game/flows/founding/shotSubject.verify.test.ts 'moves continuously' fails (radius change 39.9 mm for a 0.2 mm step). src/game/views/foundingShot.verify.test.ts 'does not jump the camera in one frame' fails (camera moved 82.6 mm in one 1/60 s frame against an allowance of 3.3 mm). Fix idea: ease the radius, centre and cutY, or the pose, in ViewDirector, or give the reach a smooth weight.

findings.title: Workers above the cut plane still widen the frame, so the real outcome card shows a tiny cell
findings.detail: Workers within 10 BU count toward the radius even when they are above cutY. Those workers are cut away with the soil cap and can never be seen. In the implementer's own real run (test-output/look5/firstplay/seed1-until12b.log, 'shot at outcome'), workers up the shaft at y +5.8 and +6.5 (22 mm above the queen at -16.66, cutY -14.26) pushed the subject radius to 33 mm. The card picture seed1-until12b/12-outcome-card.png therefore shows a cell about 150 px across with one speck of an ant at its rim, and task item 1 ('queen, first workers and brood all in view') is not met on the real path. The good card picture item1/final2-s1 comes from a cheat-completed opening. Reproduction: shotSubject.verify.test.ts 'does not widen the frame for a worker above the cut plane' fails (radius 31.3 mm against 4 mm).

findings.title: Report blames the sim (queen lays in the shaft throat) for the empty real time-lapse; the evidence says otherwise
findings.detail: The report says the real time-lapse shows an almost empty cell because the queen lays in the shaft throat. Two runs contradict this. (a) My real seed-1 run (test-output/look5-review/shot-s1/11-timelapse.png) has the queen in the throat (y +4.55, chamber centre y -11.1): the cut is 2.4 mm above her in open space (field +0.82; soil starts 8.2 mm above her), and the picture shows her and the eggs clearly. (b) The run the report cites for the empty cell (seed1-until12b) logged the queen at y -16.16, on the chamber's low edge, not in the throat: about 8 mm from the record centre and just outside the fitted ellipsoid. The cut sat at a fixed 0.6 BU above her (cutY -13.76). The frame centre, where queen and brood are, is soil and grey rim in 11-timelapse.png, so she was probably under the cap. Likely cause, in the app and fixable inside owned paths: FSHOT_CUT_ABOVE_BU puts the plane 0.6 BU above the animals without checking the carve field, so under a low roof the plane is above the ceiling. A fix could test field(q.x, cutY, q.z) > 0, or set the plane between the queen and the first solid sample above her. The sim request 'record against carve breaks the time-lapse subject' (needs #4) is not supported as the cause of the shot problem, and the MANUAL sentence 'because she lays in the shaft throat' repeats the wrong cause.

findings.title: Reduced motion: the time-lapse shows one static still; no crossfade every 3 s
findings.where: src/game/views/viewDirector.ts update() (shotYaw is frozen under reducedMotion); GDD 08 section 7.10 and App E 18
findings.detail: GDD 08 7.10 says that with reduced motion the camera is static and the view crossfades between stills every 3 real s, and App E 18 checks this. The new shot only stops the orbit, so the whole 75 s lapse is one still. src/game/views/foundingShot.test.ts asserts the static camera but not the crossfade. This was missing before the task as well, but the new shot now owns the lapse camera. GDD 06 5.11's 'warm dim light, constant (no day/night flicker)' is also not done: the implementer's lapse pictures are night-dark.

findings.title: Resolved alerts are dropped during normal play too (hand-over banner, intro card, winter banner, flight prompts), not just under centre cards
findings.detail: The feed's cardUp uses isBlockingCardUp. That is also true for the founding hand-over banner, which stays up to HANDOVER_BANNER_MAX_S = 45 s of ordinary play in the top band, and for the winter banner and the flight prompts. During those times a clearing alert skips GDD 08 6.3's 4 s 'Resolved' state. The report and the MANUAL say the rule covers only 'the time-lapse, its result card and the winter report'. The root cause of the original symptom (a Resolved card staying up across a 75 s lapse, longer than its 4 s lifetime) was also never found; a flapping raise/clear would explain it, and the new rule would hide it rather than fix it.

Interrupt beats are T2 and never raised (src/sim/colony/founding/commands.ts respond(): 'no interrupt is raised yet'). findings.title: shotSubject comment claims no per-call allocation, but two closures are allocated every frame
findings.detail: The header says 'nothing allocated per call but the out record', yet core() and widen() are new closures on every call, and the call runs every frame (twice when peekPose runs). The cost is small; the comment is wrong. Each call also scans all ants and all brood: fine during the founding, but the shot stays on in the observer view until Continue.

notDone: Root cause of the original 'Founding chamber flooding - Resolved' card standing under the outcome card is not found. By code it expires by real clock after 4 s, so it was either a flapping raise/clear or a picture taken within 4 s of a clear at the lapse end. I could not reproduce it in the browser, and the centre-card rule only hides the symptom.
Roof clamp: only unit-test evidence, because the real seed-1 run had no closer roof. A low-roof founding in the browser was not staged.

Constant light: one-frame light change when the shot starts and ends. The dip-fade is assumed to cover the start; the end was not checked. No automated test for FrameInfo.lightHour reaching the world frame; only the harness picture covers it.
Reduced-motion crossfade: tested in the ViewDirector only (dip value). The full-screen fade drawn by the app was not seen in a browser.

In the real seed-1 outcome the queen sits at the cell's low rim (y -16.66 mm). The frame is centred on her, so soil fills part of the picture. A framing that included the free space of the cell would need the sim's open space, or a different subject rule. Not done.
